brief.offer: Voice actors and audio production for language-learning content

facts.claim: Duolingo offers language learning through a freemium model, keeping learning free while monetizing a paid experience.
facts.excerpt: Duolingo started as a free product, and we remain committed to offering free learning for all while monetizing through a valuable paid experience.

facts.claim: In its Q2 report on August 5, 2026, Duolingo reported 58.7 million daily active users, up 23%.
facts.excerpt: In the Q2 report on August 5, 2026, daily active users (DAU) grew 23% to 58.7 million.
facts.source_title: The Market Called Duolingo an AI Casualty. Its Users Just Said Otherwise

facts.claim: Duolingo runs more than 1,000 A/B tests per quarter as part of its focus on product quality.
facts.excerpt: We obsess over product quality, running 1,000+ A/B tests per quarter

facts.claim: In 2026, nine of Duolingo's most popular language courses reached B2 level.
facts.excerpt: In 2026, we reached a major milestone: nine of our most popular language courses now extend to B2

facts.claim: Duolingo identifies English learners as a growth opportunity: they represent roughly 80% of language learners worldwide but only 46% of its daily active users.
facts.excerpt: We see enormous opportunity with English Learners, who represent roughly 80% of language learners worldwide but only 46% of our DAUs.
facts.source_title: Duolingo Company Strategy: How Duolingo Builds Lasting Success

facts.claim: Duolingo invests in growth primarily through product R&D, using marketing to strategically accelerate growth.
facts.excerpt: In line with our core beliefs, our investment in growth is almost all in product R&D, with marketing used to strategically accelerate growth.
facts.source_title: Duolingo Company Strategy: How Duolingo Builds Lasting Success

facts.claim: Duolingo used generative AI to scale course production, announcing 148 new language courses developed in one year in April 2025.
facts.excerpt: Using generative AI, the company has drastically scaled up production. In April 2025, von Ahn announced that the company had developed 148 new language courses in a year.
facts.source_title: Duolingo Is One of the Most Interesting AI Plays Nobody's Talking About | The Motley Fool

facts.claim: Duolingo's paid subscribers increased 17% to 12.7 million in the Q2 2026 reporting context.
facts.source_title: The Market Called Duolingo an AI Casualty. Its Users Just Said Otherwise

research.website_note: Results identify duolingo.com and its investor and blog subdomains as Duolingo's official sites.

strategy.observation: In 2026, nine of Duolingo’s most popular language courses reached B2 level.
strategy.offer_link: If those B2 courses need richer listening material, voice actors and audio production could help the learning-content team create multi-speaker dialogues with varied accents, natural pacing and expressive delivery.
hypotheses: The learning-content team may be adding or refining listening exercises for these B2 courses.
Some advanced listening exercises may benefit from human performances that convey conversational nuance.
The Director of Learning Content may influence audio requirements or external production partner selection.
strategy.angle: With nine of Duolingo’s most popular courses reaching B2 this year, would human-voiced, multi-speaker listening scenarios be useful for your next content update?
strategy.fit_reason: Voice performance and audio production have a direct potential application in advanced language-learning content, making the offer relevant to this role; an actual need for external production remains unconfirmed.

draft.subject: Listening material for B2 courses
draft.body:
With nine courses reaching B2 this year, my guess is you may be refining listening exercises for more advanced learners.

We provide voice actors and audio production for language-learning content. If you're adding multi-speaker dialogues, we could help create scenes with varied accents, natural pacing and expressive delivery, giving learners practice with conversational nuance.

Is there one listening scenario in your next B2 content update where you'd consider trying a human-voiced, multi-speaker version?
